introHtml: Rainbow pet collars bring a bold, colorful statement to any promotion or event. Whether you're planning a Pride month giveaway, a pet adoption drive, or a company picnic, these collars stand out in a crowd. Made from durable nylon with a vibrant rainbow print, they offer a comfortable fit for dogs and cats alike. Add your logo or message through screen printing or embroidery to create a memorable branded accessory that pet owners will love.
